integrity: The all-parameter proof is explicit and the finite replay is only corroborative. Classical complete-bipartite graph configuration homology is treated as prior coverage rather than as a new result. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns ordered two-point configurations of \(P_{p,q}\) for \(p,q\ge2\) and Stong finite-space cores. It does not address unordered configurations, three or more particles, or minimal cardinality in a weak homotopy class. The finite verifier checks \(2\le p,q\le8\); the all-parameter claim rests on the symbolic beat-point proof.
title: Stong-core classification for ordered two-point configurations of complete height-two finite spaces
